hero.title: Secure every payment. Pay only when the work is approved.
hero.subtitle: 0% for the client, 2–10% for the provider. Not the 20–30% many marketplaces keep.

step1.title: 1. Secure Deposit
step1.desc: The client deposits funds into a tamper-proof smart contract.

step2.title: 2. Work Delivered
step2.desc: The provider completes the mission with peace of mind, knowing the funds are locked.

step3.title: 3. Release
step3.desc: Upon approval, funds are released to the provider, available for withdrawal at any time.

security.title: Security & Transparency
security.subtitle: Escrows are non-custodial: the team cannot send escrowed funds to an arbitrary address. The 3-of-5 Safe multisig can pause new activity and, in a dispute, can only split the funds between client and provider. Withdrawals of credited funds keep working even when the contracts are paused.

auditSection.title: Verified audits
auditSection.desc: Every contract that holds or distributes funds was audited by SpyWolf before launch. An audit reduces risk but cannot rule out every bug.

contractSection.title: Verified Public Contract
contractSection.desc: The source code of our escrow is public and verified on BscScan.
